Mackenzie Bovard takes his job working for the federal government very seriously, and when he goes out to get the riff-raff that defy the laws of the land, he finds them and hangs them. This one-two punch does not sit well with a local community when he comes into their midst to pick up Johnny Bishop. Johnny has turned himself around and is not only supported by his friends and neighbours, but also by the sheriff.

The winter is off to a hellish start when a blizzard slams the Coquihalla Highway. The team needs to be at their best when clearing a crashed truck off the road and the team makes a tragic discovery.

Inspector Anton Sullivan is on the hunt for an escaped prisoner who is believed to be a high risk to the public. Anton is called to a serious collision on the M56 involving a motorcyclist and multiple vehicles.

The interceptors make an early hour dash to catch a team of late night burglars and one of the suspects treats Liam to a face full of saliva. Jacko and Simon are in pursuit of a speeding driver who abandons the car and legs it.

For the first time, a pursuit is filmed from the suspect's perspective. Plus Liam and sniffer dog Louis help uncover thousands in cash and a £1/2 million of class-A drugs. Finally, a 999 call causes firearms officers to rush to Guisborough at 11pm.

PCs Chris Swash and Rowan Burt are chasing a vehicle through the roads of Chester that is refusing to stop. Plus, PC Ian Cosgrove is on the scene of a serious crash. Fortunately, there are no serious injuries.
The arrest of a suspected drug dealer; out on the roads, Mozza and Jonny pull a drink driver who's more than three times the legal limit at four in the afternoon.

A new winter season starts with Jamie Davis heavy rescue split in two: Adam has taken half the fleet north to Alberta's rich and dangerous oil fields while Jamie stays back to fight and keep the Coquihalla Highway open all by himself.
